title: Fleet headroom analysis and rightsize recommendation engine
creator: Anika Shah
description: Build a forecasting and recommendation pipeline that converts recent fleet telemetry into actionable rightsizing suggestions and headroom policies for Dedicated pools. This ticket focuses on the offline model, dashboard, and a lightweight API used by Console and the autoscaler to apply conservative rightsizes and headroom tuning. Goal: reduce committed GPU cost by at least 8% for long-running pools while keeping P95 token latency regressions below 5%.
background: Current recommendations are heuristic (fixed-util thresholds + manual overrides) and produce noisy suggestions that ops teams distrust. We've seen recurring overprovisioning on pools with bursty diurnal patterns and underprovisioning for pools serving multimodal workloads (short chat vs long recv). Building a probabilistic occupancy model plus a packing-efficiency metric will let us recommend commit adjustments and headroom buffers tied to SLO risk rather than raw utilization.
acceptance_criteria: Offline model that ingests 14 days of per-pool timeseries (utilization, avg seq length, active requests) and computes a 30-day commit forecast with 90% and 99% CI
Dashboard widget in Console showing forecast, recommended commit delta, confidence band, and primary drivers
API endpoint /v1/rightsize-suggestion that returns recommended commit, suggested headroom percentage, and risk score (0-100)
Recommendations validated in canary: apply to 10 non-production pools for 7 days with automated rollback on SLO violation
Documentation + runbook for applying suggestions and interpreting risk score
work_items: Define telemetry inputs: per-pool qps, sustained throughput, avg token/sec, seq length distribution, hot-model fraction
Prototype a stochastic demand simulator to validate model behavior under bursty diurnal traffic
Implement occupancy forecast using quantile regression (LightGBM) and baseline ARIMA fallback
Design confidence-to-headroom mapping: map 90% CI to conservative buffer, 99% CI for critical pools
Expose suggestion API and integrate with autoscaler read-only mode for canary
Console dashboard: visualization, changelog for suggestions, feedback capture for SREs
Experiment harness to simulate applying suggestions and estimate monthly cost delta
design_decisions: Use LightGBM quantile objectives for faster training and feature importance visibility instead of deep-learning time series models
Keep recommendations conservative by default: only suggest downsizes >= 10% and never below a minimum headroom footprint of 15% unless pool is non-production
Treat model hotness (fraction of requests pinned to a single model family) as a multiplier on required headroom to avoid eviction cascades
Store results in a separate read-only index (rightsize-suggestions) to avoid mixing with high-cardinality telemetry indices
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Model overfits seasonal anomalies (e.g., launch-day spikes) — Mitigation: use rolling window with holiday masking and apply higher CI for <14-day history
Risk: Suggesting aggressive downsizes causes SLO breaches — Mitigation: canary in read-only, revert automations with multi-epoch rollback and require manual approval for >=30% change
Risk: Packing efficiency misrepresents heterogeneous GPU types — Mitigation: normalize by vram and theoretical fp-throughput; maintain per-hardware calibration constants
metrics_to_track: Aggregate monthly committed GPU hours saved
P95 token latency change for canary pools
Autoscaler override rate after applying suggestions
Fraction of suggestions accepted by SREs/owners
implementation_notes: Telemetry schema: reuse existing fleet metrics; add a compact 'occupancy_snapshot' series at 1m granularity
Feature engineering: include rolling percentiles (5/50/95) of seq_length and request interarrival times
Model training infra: iterate on a batch job in infra-models namespace and schedule daily retrain
API contract: JSON response with fields [pool_id, recommended_commit_gpus, recommended_headroom_pct, confidence_90, confidence_99, drivers]
Privacy: no customer request payloads in training data — only aggregated telemetry
Observability: add tracing spans for forecast pipeline and instrument latency on the suggestion API
qa_plan: Unit tests for feature engineering transformation and packing efficiency calculation
Integration test running a synthetic workload through simulator and asserting predicted occupancy within 10% of simulated
Load test API at 500 qps to ensure sub-100ms p50 suggestion response time
Run canary across 10 non-prod pools for 7 days and verify no SLO regressions
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (Week 1-2): Internal-only dashboard and read-only API; gather SRE feedback
Stage 2 (Week 3): Canary apply on non-prod pools with auto-rollback metrics wired
Stage 3 (Week 4-6): Gradual opt-in for low-risk production pools with manual approval
Stage 4 (Week 7+): Evaluate enabling automated downsizing for pools with >60% historical stability
